page.overview:
Who is Foot Sumo Ninja?

Foot Sumo Ninja (referred to as Mega Foot in the Prima Game Guide) are enemies that appear exclusively in the console version of the video game Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2: Battle Nexus, being first seen in the future world where the reunited and fought with Slashuur. They later appear in as guards alongside many , , and . Foot Sumo Ninja are tall, obese warriors, but despite their size they can run quickly and are quite tough to beat in battle due to their high amounts of health, being capable of blocking, are not able to be picked up and thrown, can inflict tons of damage, and are able to temporarily cause the player's movement controls to reverse with one of their attacks. Despite their overall high offensive and defensive power, Foot Sumo Ninjas don't usually attack unless they are disturbed by the player.
